Rapid growth

Data Center Boom

Manassas has six years to get ready for 100 MW of new data centers. They'll need power all night. What will you run after sunset?

Play Data Center Boom↗ Your decisions ↓

Choose your difficulty before you start. It’s free to play in your browser.

Location
Manassas, Virginia
Starts in
2020
Your term
16 years

Your starting point

In 2020, your municipal utility serves 16,500 customers with a gas peaker and an aging oil plant.

The developers offer to help pay for the full connection. Take the money and you'll need all 100 MW ready in January 2026. Turn it down and you can connect half then and the other half in January 2028.

Learn how to play

Your decisions

  1. 01

    Negotiate the connection

    Compare the grant with the cost of getting new capacity ready by 2026. Phasing in the connection also delays half the new sales.

  2. 02

    Cover the night shift

    Look at demand after sunset. How much energy can you store during the day, and what will supply the rest?

  3. 03

    Keep the city's customers

    Check what residents pay while you build. If your rates drive them away, you lose sales from the people you already serve.

Would you take the developers' money?
